notes.title: "I Am Caligula" Panties update.
notes.content:
I am happy to see so many people playing the game! After reading all the comments I have put out a update for the game based on your feedback.

One review said they did not like the choices I made in the equipment your party can use. I understand options are important, so now you can also wear your sister Drusilla's panties on your head into battle! Enjoy!

Oh and I fixed those typos/grammar people pointed out as well...

Patch Notes 
"Panties" added to the game
Grammar fixes
